name: Healthy Immunity
description: Roll ALL Immunity rolls at Advantage

name: Thick Headed
description: Roll ALL Resolve rolls at Advantage

name: Uncanny Abilities
description: Gain or Increase Proficiency in 2 Skills

name: Moving Target
description: Add +1 to Initiative and +5 to Dodge

name: Fleet Footed
description: Can make 1 Movement Action as a Free Action ONCE per Action Phase

powers.name: Premonition
powers.description: Character can roll their Dodge against ALL attacks, including against UNSEEN Enemies.

powers.name: Psychic Armor
powers.description: Character has 3 Armor Points unless UNCONCIOUS.

powers.name: Telekinesis
powers.description: Characters can lift and carry an object up to 10 with their mind, and move it up to Midrange as 1 Complex Action. This item can be thrown Short range, with an Intelligence Base Stat roll as a second Complex Action.

powers.name: Telepathy
powers.description: Character may send and receive a mental message to/from any target within Short Range. Character can increase this range +1 per Degree of Success with a Resolve Special Stat roll.

powers.name: Divination
powers.description: Character roll their Luck Base Stat during each Long Rest or Sleep. They may ask 1 question to the Gamemaster per Degree of Success.

powers.name: Psychosymmetry
powers.description: Character may link their mind with ANY Target within Short Range and blend thoughts to obtain information. The Target can Resist with an Opposed Resolve Special Stat roll. If the character is successful, they gain memories from the Target AND Advantage on subsequent Charm or Intimidate skill rolls.

powers.name: Psychophysiology
powers.description: Character may exchange 1 Hunger Damage for +5 Initiative for 1 Combat Round.

powers.name: Trance
powers.description: With a successful Resolve roll, characters may remove a Resolve or Insanity Condition, decrease Stages of Infection by 1 per Degree of Success, or regain 2 lost HP per Degree of Success.

powers.name: Enhancement
powers.description: Character gains +10 to any Base Stat.

powers.name: Reflex
powers.description: Character gains +10 to their Dodge Special Stat.

name: Strong Fortitude
description: Roll ALL Resilience rolls at Advantage
